# Morning Routine Sender

> Automated, timezone-aware daily morning routine email delivery system engineered for peak focus, mindset reflections, and habit streak tracking.

## Core Overview
Morning Routine Sender delivers personalized, high-signal morning rituals directly to subscribers' inboxes at their local wake-up time. The platform features curated content personas (Deep Work, Stoic Mindfulness, Executive Leverage, Lifelong Learning, and Morning Energizer), 1-click habit check-in streak tracking, an interactive 25-minute Pomodoro focus companion with procedural ambient soundscapes, and zero-ad-tracking privacy.

## Key Capabilities & Architecture
- **Timezone-Aware Cron Engine**: Automated dispatch synced to subscriber wake-up schedules across all global IANA timezones.
- **5 Curated Persona Tracks**:
  1. *Deep Work & Builder*: Distraction-free sprint protocols, developer wisdom, and maker focus.
  2. *Mindfulness & Stoic*: Breathwork, gratitude rituals, and Marcus Aurelius / Seneca reflections.
  3. *High-Performance Exec*: Top 3 non-negotiables, strategic leverage, and delegation frameworks.
  4. *Lifelong Learner*: Mental models, active recall principles, and book insights.
  5. *Morning Energizer*: Affirmations, hydration prompts, and morning momentum.
- **Habit Streak & Focus Companion**: 1-click email check-in tracking with instant live web timer and procedural Web Audio ambient focus soundscapes (Rain & Storm, Ocean Waves, 40Hz Binaural Beats, Deep Flow Tone).
- **Accountability Squads & Peer Streaks**: Collaborative habit squads (up to 5 peers) with unique invite codes, collective aggregate streaks, and real-time team accountability.
- **Deep Habit Analytics & Audio Briefings**: 7d/30d completion metrics, time-of-day peak energy windows, and persona-tailored morning audio briefings.
- **Rich Push Notification Actions**: 1-click lock screen check-ins, routine launchers, and 15-minute snoozes via Service Worker.
- **Privacy & Security**: Zero tracking pixels, passwordless magic links, instant self-service preference management, and RFC-compliant 1-click unsubscribe.
